title: Hackers hit AI coding tool OpenCode, running up charges on users’ AI accounts | TechCrunch
summary: OpenCode later received access to OpenAI’s Daybreak Blue program, which gives vetted users AI models that are less likely to refuse requests for defensive security work. The breach occurred the same night OpenCode made GLM-5.3-Flash free for users.
